The native source pair shows a 47-calendar-day movement at Ground Works Finish and a 37-calendar-day movement at Project Finish after the Batch 03 fragnet is introduced. The same 24 relationship signatures exist in both models. Eleven rows connect Longest Path activities before the fragnet and 12 after the fragnet, confirming material path relevance. The controlled copies apply exactly 18 FS lag resets and six relationship deletions, but their exported finish dates remain the source dates because no native P6 recalculation has been performed. The exact reduction, increase or path switch caused by the 24 treatments is therefore still unknown.

Import and recalculate the source and controlled before/after pairs under identical P6 settings. Record both milestones, total float and longest/float paths. Do not unconditionally accept that the original programme was defective. If the correction set is commercially acceptable after the steel test, seek written Engineer/Employer agreement naming the controlled XER and validation cut-off as the fixed analytical basis for Claim No. 1, with no undisclosed later corrections and no waiver of STR-104 or any time/payment right.
